reports.description: I worked with a Mr Irtaza Ali after viewing interviews with traders on a website, I decided to make a payment through Wise. In June 2021 I was contacted by Irtaza Ali through Telegram with an opportunity to invest in cryptocurrency through the platform http://robot44trade.com/. I sent money through with my credit card. Irtaza tried to convince me to deposit more and more. In March 2022 I requested withdrawals but they asked me to pay for insurance fees.. Nonetheless, they told me my withdrawal from my cryptocurrency wallet had been stopped as I lacked a license. I remained in touch with Irtaza and he introduced me to the platform https://ultragoldmine.com/. Parallel to the to me trading with Ultra Goldmine I was contacted by an individual who introduced herself as Ashley Shannon who got my address through the Ultragoldmine portal. She suggested I needed to diversify my portfolio into cryptocurrency, cannabis and ETF  trading. I trusted her as Irtaza Ali confirmed he knew her and had been her mentor years ago. I decided to invest according to her suggestions. At the end of 2021, I made a transfer but was contacted by Dr. Irtaza and told I should cancel the transaction. Later I was contacted by another Dr. Irtaza who asked me why he had canceled the transaction. I was confused and the second Irtaza insisted to contact me through Instagram and then Telegram. In January 2022 Ashley told me they were transitioning to a new bot system and I needed to upgrade to participate in it. In March 2022 I was asked to make further payments to access the withdrawal of the alleged profits I held on the platform. In March 2022, I was contacted by Nicole, who told me she had found me through Robot44trade and offered to trade in Blocko trading. I was curious and decided to try it. They asked me to pay for recovery fees claiming I had transferred the money to an incorrect wallet, and also for the use of the software, among others.
